rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice when challenging a lower court’s decision in a higher court.

example.english: We decided to appeal this judgment.
example.traditional: 我哋決定就呢個判決上訴。
example.jyutping: ngo5 dei6 kyut3 ding6 zau6 ni1 go3 pun3 kyut3 soeng6 sou3

rows.note: Use this when something is attractive or interesting to someone, as in “That idea appeals to me.”

example.english: This idea really does appeal to me.
example.jyutping: ni1 go3 nam2 faat3 zan1 hai6 kap1 jan5 ngo5

rows.note: Use this for the power of something to attract interest; it is the all-purpose choice for this sense.

example.english: The show's appeal is so strong that even my mum can't bear to turn off the TV.
example.traditional: 呢套劇吸引力好強，連我阿媽都睇到唔捨得熄電視。
example.jyutping: ni1 tou3 kek6 kap1 jan5 lik6 hou2 koeng4 lin4 ngo5 aa3 maa1 dou1 tai2 dou3 m4 se2 dak1 sik1 din6 si6

rows.note: Use this for a public call asking people to help, support, or take action.

example.english: The government made an appeal to residents to save water.
example.jyutping: zing3 fu2 fu1 jyu6 si5 man4 haan1 seoi2

rows.meaning: legal challenge to a higher court
rows.note: Use this as the all-purpose legal term for challenging a lower court's decision or referring to the appeal proceedings; use 上訴書 for the filing document itself.

example.jyutping: bei6 gou3 kyut3 ding6 soeng6 sou3

rows.note: Use this when publicly calling on people to give help, support, or take action.

example.english: The government will appeal to the public to donate to help disaster victims.
example.traditional: 政府呼籲市民捐款幫助災民。
example.jyutping: zing3 fu2 fu1 jyu6 si5 man4 gyun1 fun2 bong1 zo6 zoi1 man4

rows.note: Use this specifically for the written legal document filed to make an appeal, not for the appeal case itself.

example.english: The lawyer has filed an appeal.
example.jyutping: leot6 si1 ji5 ging1 dai6 gaau1 soeng6 sou3 syu1
